text: What does a call frame hold?
choices: The parameters, locals, and return address for one execution of one method
All variables visible in the program
The objects a method has created
The compiled code of a method
explanation: One execution, not one method — three calls mean three frames with independent variables. That is why a local is fresh on every call, and it is what makes recursion unremarkable: two executions of one method are as separate as two of different methods.
